title: Multi-Agent Chat Interface
description: Build real-time UI for viewing swarm activity, agent status, task flow, and message history between agents
context: Once swarms are running, we need visibility into what's happening. This UI shows swarm orchestration in action - who's working on what, messages between agents, and progress toward goals.
requirements: Create SwarmChat page component in deepify-ai/src/pages/swarm-chat.tsx
Display list of active swarms with status (idle/working/blocked/complete)
Agent status indicators for each swarm participant
Task flow visualization showing orchestrator → workers relationship
Real-time message history between agents (scrollable log)
Filter messages by agent, type, or time range
Visual distinction between orchestrator (Opus) and workers (Sonnet)
Ability to select a swarm and drill into details
acceptance_criteria: Shows list of swarms with basic info (name, status, participants)
Message log shows agent-to-agent communication in chronological order
Can filter messages by agent or message type
Visual hierarchy clearly shows orchestrator vs workers
Updates in real-time as swarm progresses (use React state/hooks)
Follows Team in a Box design system

dependencies: React hooks (useState, useEffect) for real-time updates
Existing UI components from Team in a Box
ui_components: AgentStatusCard (shows agent name, status, current task)

data_structure.swarms: Array of active swarms from orchestrator
data_structure.agents: Array of participating agents with current status

design_notes.layout: Left sidebar: swarm list, Main area: selected swarm details, Right panel: agent status cards
design_notes.colors: Orchestrator = blue, Workers = green, Errors = red, Completed = gray
design_notes.icons: Use emoji or icon library for status (⏸️ idle, ⚙️ working, 🚫 blocked, ✅ done)

validation: Open page in browser, start a test swarm, verify messages appear in real-time and agent status updates correctly.
